title: InstaDeep
tagline: Three product surfaces and the design system they all run on.
summary: Senior product designer at InstaDeep, an AI research company acquired by BioNTech. I work across DeepPCB, their cloud-native PCB routing software, InstaNovo, their protein-sequencing model, and the design system every InstaDeep product surface and demo is built from.
description: Design highlights from InstaDeep — DeepPCB, InstaNovo, and the design system behind every product surface.
team: Design of one, across several product teams

sections.heading: DeepPCB
sections.body:
DeepPCB is InstaDeep's cloud-native PCB routing software — a reinforcement-learning router that takes a board layout and returns a routed one. My work covers the product's public surfaces: what the tool claims, who it claims it for, and how someone evaluating it gets from the pitch to a signed-up account.

These are the marketing and onboarding surfaces rather than the routing canvas itself.

images.caption: Home — the claim, stated once, above a routed board.
Enterprise — the same router, argued to a buyer instead of an engineer.

sections.heading: InstaNovo
sections.body:
InstaNovo and InstaNovo+ are de novo peptide sequencing models: they read a mass spectrum and return a peptide sequence without matching it against a reference database, which is the whole point — a database search can only find what is already in the database. Built with the Department of Biotechnology and Biomedicine at the Technical University of Denmark, and published in Nature Machine Intelligence.

My work was the public face of it: the logo, and a landing page that has to hold two readers at once. A proteomics researcher wants the benchmark before they want anything else — 52% average peptide accuracy across eight biological datasets, 34% more novel peptides, 42% more peptide spectrum matches. Someone deciding whether to fund or adopt it wants to know what that unlocks. So the numbers sit in a band immediately under the hero rather than being saved for a technical page, and the two models get one section each — InstaNovo transcribing, InstaNovo+ refining by diffusion — because the relationship between them is the thing people get wrong.

The set also includes the states, in the same visual language rather than a default: the 404 is built from real sequence output, and the pre-launch holding page had to look like the product it was holding.

images.alt: InstaNovo landing page, full scroll: hero, benchmark band, a section each for InstaNovo and InstaNovo+, capability cards, research and contact
images.caption: The landing page. Benchmarks in a band under the hero, not buried — a researcher reads the number before the pitch.

images.alt: Animated hero graphic: a mass spectrum on the left resolving into clusters of predicted peptide sequences on the right
images.caption: The hero animation. A mass spectrum on the left resolves into predicted sequences on the right — the model's actual job, stated once, in motion. Muted, and it does not start until you ask.

images.alt: InstaNovo pre-launch holding page with COMING SOON set large, the last letters fading out
images.caption: The pre-launch holding page. Brand only, and it still had to look like the product it was holding.

sections.heading: Design system
sections.body:
Every InstaDeep product surface and research demo is built from one system. It exists because the alternative was each team inventing its own buttons, and it had to survive being used by engineers with no designer in the room.

Browse the components below.

sections.heading: States and recovery
sections.body: The states are the part of a product nobody screenshots and everybody hits. Both products can fail in ways a marketing page never shows — a routing job that will not converge, a spectrum with no confident call, a link that has gone stale — so the error pages carry each product's own grid or sequence motif, say what happened in that product's vocabulary, and offer exactly one way back. Two products, one discipline.

images.alt: DeepPCB 404 page: a monospace 404 label, PAGE NOT FOUND set large, and a single Go to Homepage action
images.caption: DeepPCB — one message, one route out. “Off the grid” and “reconnect” are the router's own vocabulary, not generic error copy.

images.alt: InstaNovo 404 page: the headline 404 | Page not found beside a peptide-sequence field forming a shape
images.caption: InstaNovo — the field on the right is real sequence output, so even the error page is made of what the product does.
